984789f01696166b650af4f348febd5cb9d6bce8.QuestDescription: In the depths of Maraudon lives a creature of chaos and evil, $N. Princess Theradras is an elemental force of earth related somehow to the Old Gods. Ages ago, she was sought out by Zaetar, first son of Cenarius. The offspring of their... relationship are the creatures known as centaur. Ever-thankful creatures, the centaur killed Zaetar, and now Theradras keeps his remains. My quest here is to find those powerful enough to slay Theradras so we may recover Zaetar's remains before returning to Stonetalon.

9847a5f06be7ee668335c276f40f2fce82e2983b.QuestDescription: I miss my brother, Jheel.  He's a couple of years older than me, so they let him start an apprenticeship with the ethereal in Nagrand.$B$BIt sure would be nice to go visit him.  He loves geology and stuff, so I bet he's having a great time.$B$BThe orphan matron told me that he's training at a place called Aeris Landing in Nagrand.  It's supposed to be along the road, far to the west of Telaar, and northwest of the great mountain, Oshu'gun.

By all accounts, Gorefiend was a warlock of Gul'dan - extremely powerful in his own right. 98b467e44a75fde528b3a47f09d64581ca14de0a.Text: Listen to me, $n. You must fight against the Lich King's control. He is a monster that wants to see this world - our world - in ruin. Don't let him use you to accomplish his goals. You were once a hero and you can be again. Fight, damn you! Fight his control!

98b62a74c87c2bf4ad14c26c53b94c411279301e.Text: The time of the Raven is nigh, but yours will end here!

98b74fde04ed6348caa04b1b8408a2291989ef36.LogDescription: Take the portal to Undercity located in Grommash Hold and report to Vol'jin.
98b74fde04ed6348caa04b1b8408a2291989ef36.QuestDescription: On the day of my death I wish to be able to say that I lived a life without regret. Those who mourn my passing will know that I was a Warchief who made decisions that best served his people.$B$BBut this betrayal by Varimathras and Putress... All that we have worked for is for nothing.$B$B<Thrall's chest heaves with a heavy sigh.>$B$BJustice must be served.$B$BPortals to Undercity will be active momentarily. Vol'jin will be waiting for you. I will meet you there soon. Together we will make it right, $N.

98b82f12ab7b47d796b470896ffe1bab1120b442.Text: I was personally assured by Malygos that your commander would make the details of this accord his top priority. Now let me pass!

texts.text0_0: Mortals, I am indebted to you for freeing me from the terrible corruption that besets this place. Though I have not yet recovered fully, I can help you battle Yogg-Saron.$B$BI can grant you and your friends the Resilience of Nature, increasing your damage and increasing healing taken from spells and effects. In addition, I can conjure Sanity Wells that will allow you to recover your Sanity when your grip on reality falters.

98c040356b732eff89fd7aeaf485a606ddc0e813.LogDescription: Return to Wildhammer Stronghold and speak with Kurdran Wildhammer.
98c040356b732eff89fd7aeaf485a606ddc0e813.QuestDescription: You must bring word of our success to Kurdran Wildhammer immediately! His men, under Wing Commander Nuainn, have fought nonstop to keep Wildhammer Stronghold safe and your return will surely bolster their spirits. With the threat from the Legion out of the way, Kurdran can finally turn his attention to dealing with the forces of Illidan. Our place here is far from secure, but we've won a major victory this day.

98c0c4c6f4a1211ecbee2911d9f252e5a63039a2.RewardText: Caught him, huh? Good for you. I'm surprised that was Slim.$B$BI'll be honest, I never thought I'd miss the excitement of some of the more devious underground activities. I guess old habits die hard. Don't mention that to Elling--he'd probably try and get me to come back to Stormwind if he heard I missed the action.$B$BI'm glad I could at least be of a little service to you while you were in Menethil. If you need anything else, just ask.

texts.text0_1: Here for a ride, $r?$B$BOr, is something else bothering you?

98c36b4574a470d06bff01846adf5b68b0f5e79f.LogDescription: Speak to Bat Handler Camille at Vengeance Landing and obtain passage to the Windrunner.  Report to Captain Harker aboard the ship.
98c36b4574a470d06bff01846adf5b68b0f5e79f.QuestDescription: We have the Windrunner, the Queen's Reprisal and the Oblivion stationed just east of the Derelict Strand.  Send orders to the fleet's commander, Captain Harker, that they're to destroy the Alliance's cannons.$B$BSpeak to our bat handler, Camille, and ask for passage to the fleet's location.  Be quick, $N, every minute we spend fighting the Alliance is a minute we could've spent fighting Arthas.

98c537e0c8cc6bc6feec256379d91bc13e3afb37.OptionText: I've lost my Tabard of the Protector.

98d0c61f8d7b10e5058beeda3d2cba135675952e.LogDescription: Magister Ilastar at Sun's Reach Armory wants you to slay 6 Dawnblade Summoners, 6 Dawnblade Blood Knights and 3 Dawnblade Marksmen.
98d0c61f8d7b10e5058beeda3d2cba135675952e.QuestDescription: One of Kael's most elite forces, the Dawnblade army, has been stationed at the Sun's Reach Harbor and Dawnstar Village.$B$BThe harbor is of critical importance to our plans, so any Dawnblade casualties you inflict will be of tremendous help.  Kael'thas will rue the day that he turned his back on his people and sided with the Burning Legion.

98d3123e080ea5d554a7a5227aff47dfc8ecb929.LogDescription: Take the Cleverly Encrypted Letter to Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge.
98d3123e080ea5d554a7a5227aff47dfc8ecb929.QuestDescription: I have a colleague in Ironforge who may be able to help decrypt this letter.  Go to the Library in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge and speak with Prospector Stormpike.  Tell him I sent you and show him the letter.  If there's anyone north of Blackrock Spire who can read this, it is he.

98d6ebc464c524af9d57fba47c1752af0fcac718.Text: Some things are better left alone!

texts.text0_1: Hail, $c.  The Ironforge Brigade is stationed here to keep an eye on Hive'Zora.  The Cenarion Circle druids have been monitoring silithid movement and they're anticipating something major in this area.

98d998eaf501724cbb7ca8bc69e2ec026f982e1b.warning: Context/conditions not assigned; use only stable supported identity, never infer availability.

98dbdd95c3ec59910cecc8a94051cb7a0697807c.Text: The tablet has the confirmation we need, just as I thought. Now, we have to use this information to draw out and defeat this Anzu before he can do any more damage to the Emerald Dream!

98dcbc292573521fd3bf0216fb3ed4cb7e085e26.LogDescription: Speak with the Brewfest Spy in the Grim Guzzler of Blackrock Depths.$B
98dcbc292573521fd3bf0216fb3ed4cb7e085e26.QuestDescription: $n, our spies have discovered a fiendish plot!  The Dark Iron dwarves want our beloved Brewfest destroyed!$B$BCoren Direbrew, head of a renegade family of brewers, has marshaled the dwarves of Blackrock Depths.  Their vile mole machines attack us constantly.$B$BOur spy is in the Grim Guzzler, a tavern in the bowels of Blackrock Depths.  He'll know more of Direbrew's plot.$B$BFind our spy.  Save Brewfest!

98dde09a297bd8ec2ec9a24f753187da595aac1b.Text: Anti-escape countermeasures activated. Self-destruct in t-minus 20 seconds....

98de393d2fcd7b68a9dbc76056352de6991b1a6a.Text: Blathering idiot. You incomprehensibly incompetent buffoon...

98de52e0ca393790bbd479d9c11a3b6c95c5b407.RewardText: <Chu'a'lor's left head begins to speak.>$B$BThese will do fine.$B$BRemember, $B, the value of the shard is not in what it can purchase for you. It is not even in what it can potentially do for you when properly forged, though there is some debate over that.$B$B<His right head finishes,...>$B$BThe true value is in the journey to attain the shard.

98dfb4dbddcc6c83bc44a811f3941997025a533a.LogDescription: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Armsplint.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.$B$BMaywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
98dfb4dbddcc6c83bc44a811f3941997025a533a.LogTitle: Paragons of Power: The Augur's Bracers
98dfb4dbddcc6c83bc44a811f3941997025a533a.QuestDescription: The augurs of our tribe are revered for their gifts of the divine sight, ya mon.  They ain't a witch doctor; they spend their time castin' bones or readin' the leaves for insight - not hexin' people.  As a shaman, you already know somethin' about the power of augury; we Zandalar prize the insight they give to the tribe.$B$BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us.  Do this for us, and I'll give ya some bracers that our augurs prize above all others!

98e0ebc4d2bd0a26a36af0ebb2b2c8705d3370cf.RewardText: You've found the body of a young draenei paladin.  He appears to have been slain by a blow to his back.

98e25bfa162072fb84c01e354613e0e6378946d5.Text: Oh, come on! My cart broke, my horse lost a shoe, and now the cargo goes bad!

98e38d38b77d8b7c4a51710e0da0b4ef4ce6bd89.Text: Calf killer! Murderer! You will pay for this!

98e5599a0246b6902c68748089ba1b1af80e7289.Text: I hate to disappoint people, but the Stone Crow's closed. If the kids from the orphanage were evacuated, I don't see why we should be open, either.

98e61e572725041e4b7bf7d07f310f88c85e8320.RewardText: $N! You bring joy to this old dwarf's heart.$B$BYou have now proven yourself; you've joined the ranks of the elite! Others ran away in fear, or died, trampled under the foot of the beast. You used your mind, your cunning, your determination to prove your mastery of the hunt.$B$BTake this and know that you are always welcome to hunt at my side!

98e7723fdd81770c12e0721ea974a4765f411fe6.Text: Well, I suppose I do owe you a little something - here, take one of these. I've got lots.

98e8c8b080a851a399f58a8a16895e96aca7cf1d.LogDescription: Travel to Kalimdor, to the coastal city of Theramore. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!
98e8c8b080a851a399f58a8a16895e96aca7cf1d.QuestDescription: I'm a dwarf fer cryin' out loud, $g lad:missy;! I ain't been designed to fish! I mean look at me! I'm practically made outta stone.$B$BI got nothin' left - ye tapped me out. I've taught ye all I know, flipflop!$B$BDon't ye get it? Ah, fine. I got an ol' friend over on Kalimdor who can help ye out. 'Is name be Nat Pagle, a fine lad. Find him on the islands south o' Theramore. Git goin'!

98e9c6a306c571702758bb392273f4292efc0559.OptionText: Show me where I can fly.

98e9c854e6093150252d1651a9096df650936204.CompletionText: What business is it you wish to speak of, $N? You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.

98eb616b687bfe3f7f8bf839cb3f4a87d75ce32e.CompletionText: The ring, $N!  Please... tell me you've found it!

98ecb3319f91df36a76c793960f3cba44013799b.LogDescription: Report to Ground Commander Xutjja at the edge of the glacier north of Ymirheim.
98ecb3319f91df36a76c793960f3cba44013799b.QuestDescription: We need more men to join the main assault on Ymirheim.$B$BAny warrior with half a brain can tell you that vrykul are fierce fighters and should not be taken lightly. That goes two-fold for the Ymirjar. They have shown us no restraint in proving why the Lich King deemed them worthy.$B$BGround Commander Xutjja is overseeing the assault. The city itself is located in the center of Icecrown - Xutjja's troops are positioned near the edge of the glacier, north of the city.

98f574fc2be9848e0f7ffc3a819042bb4f0ffcd4.RewardText: That'll stop 'em - at least I think it'll stop 'em. Either way, you've done your part. That's all an $r can ask for, no?
